title: Section 4 Reference Fixture — Multi-Source Heartbeat, Backfill & Disagreement
description: Deterministic synthetic receiver-clock scenario (12s duration, 5s heartbeat threshold). Sources A and B share declared dependency gateway-1 with distinct power labels (power-1 vs power-2); Source C has unknown dependency declarations and never transmits. Demonstrates exact threshold boundary (T=5), historical backfill reception without heartbeat restoration (T=6), stale-to-fresh heartbeat receipt recovery (T=7), and comparable categorical observation disagreement (T=2).
